predeclared_discriminator: Bounded primary-source coordinate inventory only. Search the frozen fusion/cover ancestry plus explicit graph, communication, rectangle/partition, rank/discrepancy, certificate/description and target-relative trace-potential source families for an already-defined coordinate Q(A,B). A row is an ADMISSIBLE_MATCH only if the inspected primary source and an explicit assumption-preserving translation jointly establish all of: (1) Q is distinct from rho(A,B), D_cap(A|B) and D_cap^circ(A|B), rather than a renaming or target-dependent reconstruction restatement; (2) every legal shared integral m-pair full cover implies a universal construction-side upper bound Q(A,B)<=f(m); (3) the transfer preserves integrality, common-resource multiplexing, unrestricted noncanonical full semi-filter obligations and cheap-target controls; (4) Q is target-relative or invariant under free union closure of B, so zero-cost base expressivity cannot make it large; and (5) an explicitly named target family has a proved source-side lower bound Q=omega(log N) strong enough, with the recorded implication direction, to force rho=omega(log N). Wigderson 1995 must be inspected for the branching-model restriction or retained as a primary-source CANNOT_CHECK scope gap; Karchmer 1993 and Nakayama-Maruoka 1995 retrieval must be retried but missing content cannot be converted into a bounded-family no-match claim. For every row record exact quantifiers, theorem polarity, legal pair/model class, source-to-target map, broken assumptions, non-guarantees and a row-level DifferenceWitness. ADMISSIBLE_MATCH maps to SUCCESS without candidate generation; exhaustive NO_ADMISSIBLE_COORDINATE maps to FAILURE only if every frozen primary-source family is inspected; any required inaccessible or insufficiently aligned source maps to BLOCKED/CANNOT_CHECK. Computation may test hostile finite controls but cannot establish a universal inequality, explicit-family asymptotic lower bound, novelty or P-versus-NP authority.
